title: UN votes to partition Palestine
summary: The United Nations General Assembly adopted Resolution 181, recommending that Mandatory Palestine be divided into Jewish and Arab states with Jerusalem under international control.
reason: Britain had given up the mandate, and the UN sought a solution to the conflicting claims of Jews and Arabs.
significance: The vote led directly to the creation of Israel and the first Arab-Israeli war.
place: Flushing Meadows, New York, United States
